lines.text: Joshua and all the Israelites leave Shittim early in the morning and camp at the Jordan before crossing.
The officers tell the people to follow the ark carried by the Levitical priests, staying two thousand cubits back.
The LORD tells Joshua He will exalt him so all Israel may know He is with him as He was with Aaron.
When the priests' feet touch the water, the Jordan stands still and backs up as far as Adam, near Bethel.
The priests carrying the ark stand firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan until the entire nation crosses.
